text: Delivered in merge 87e4998 (commits 68626ee, fcf943a). RelationTruthTableSuite: hand-written 4x4 accept/reject grids for All, SameOn, DifferentOn, every And leaf combination, the fluent facade, heterogeneous key types and the phase table; pinned pair lists for every PairDesign inhabitant and reductions (ByLeft/ByRight, EdgesOnce/MirroredEndpoints); ScalaCheck laws for and-commutativity/associativity/idempotence at the interpreter, All identity, SameOn/DifferentOn complementarity, symmetry for identical projections, and a hash-join oracle for joinKeys. SamplingMutationSuite: ten real alternative samplers (focal-blind, stream-sequenced, arrival-order, cap off-by-one both ways, cap-in-priority, tie-arrival, tie-random, render-digest, match-after-sample) each shown killed by a named property while Selection.bottomK passes; golden selection and focal digest/priority pinned as literals identical on JVM and JS. Fresh-context review found no blockers; its items were fixed. designJVM/JS 137/137 on main. Doc findings: Relation.joinKeys is not used by any execution path (PRD X-2 hash-join claim is declarative only); Selection.bottomKBy doc slightly overstates tie handling (stable sort falls back to arrival order on a 64-bit collision).
